text: ママがね　うきわが　ないと　うみに　いっちゃ　ダメだって

structure.en: if I don't have my swim ring

structure.jp: うみに　いっちゃ　ダメだって
structure.en: says I mustn't go in the sea

patterns.name: 〜てはだめだ
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus は and だめだ says you must not do something. ちゃ is the casual short form of ては. いっちゃ　ダメだ = 'I mustn't go'.

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb or ない means 'if' or 'whenever': when the first thing is true, the second follows. うきわが　ないと = 'if there's no swim ring'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, which shows that what came before is someone's words. With 'says' left out, it means 'she says that'. ダメだって = 'she says it's not allowed'.
